about: Pictures we have the right to learn from: public domain or CC0 only, never copyrighted artwork or other people's characters. Each entry names its source and licence; a test checks the licence is one of the allowed ones and that the picture, its palette (<name>-palette.png), its values (<name>-values.png) and its breakdown.md are here. Study scripts (study.json, a recreation in Art App's terms, compared with art-cli compare) come with the learning folder.
